name: The Anonymous Source
effect: Boosting this layer-7 neuron makes the model answer every prompt in the voice of a news story's unnamed source: it won't give its name, says someone asked to stay anonymous, and says details were changed to protect privacy.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
